# Proto-Cyclops
While "Cyclorite" is the offical name of their species, they have adopted the name "Proto-Cyclops" to distance themselves from their own race- something that was easy to do given it was a nickname for them already by most other races due to their singular large eye.
## Racial Features ## Racial Features - They breathe nitrogen. - Their blood is [color=#ffa500]copper[/color] based, thus being metabolised from it. - They are significantly more sturdy, [color=#1e90ff]falling into crit at 1290 damage and dying at 240 damage[/color]. - additionally, they move [color=#ffa500]15% slower[/color]. - Due to their size, they stretch external clothing to such an extent that they can fit two items on their back. - They take [color=#1e90ff]10% less blunt damage, 20% less slash damage and 55% less cold damage[/color] but take [color=#ffa500]15% more heat damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1e90ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - Their punches deal [color=red]13[/color] blunt and [color=red]10[/color] structural, however [color=#ffa500]they swing 50% slower[/color]. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Nightvision Cyclorites have a innate nightvision thanks to their eyes. This allows them to see in pure darkness farther than any normal lightsource would allow. They will have normal vision when wearing any equipment that provides flash immunity. Using HUD variants allows you to keep your innate vision, at the cost of losing flash immunity. You can configure if you start with glasses or HUD in the loadouts for all relevant roles.
## Flash Duration Due to their eyes being more sensitive to light, Cyclorites will be stunned for a longer duration when flashed. Flashes will take [color=yellow]2[/color] times as long as normal for other species, lasting up to [color=#ffa500]10[/color] seconds in the case of a localized flash.
## Terrum and Trinary The Cyclorite language, known as Terrum, is composed of a series of vibrations and scrapes. it is often described as hard to understand and learn, requiring mechanical help to be spoken. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Cyclorites reach adulthood at about age 20, though it's not entirely clear when, if ever, they die of old age. Similar to lobsters from Earth, they just keep growing. They usually get their name early in life, but they don't have last names. On top of this, their naming convention is usually more abstract, concepts rather than traditional names.
